Settings.MenuHint: Atlas address, campaign and sign-in for this world.
Settings.Title: Atlas Settings

BaseUrl.Name: Atlas base URL
BaseUrl.Hint: The address you open Atlas at in your browser (frontend URL), e.g. https://atlas.example.com. Both /api/v1 and /socket.io must be reachable from there.

Settings.BaseUrlMissingScheme: The base URL is missing http:// or https:// — connections will fail until it's added.

ShowSceneLinks.Name: Show scene links bar
ShowSceneLinks.Hint: Toggles the Atlas links bar at the top of the canvas.

QuietMode.Name: Quiet notifications
QuietMode.Hint: Suppresses only the new-notification toast — the bell badge stays accurate.

AutoOpenGmSuggestions.Name: Auto-open GM suggestions
AutoOpenGmSuggestions.Hint: Opens the viewer automatically when the GM wants to show you a document, instead of a confirmation toast.

ShowBell.Name: Show bell
ShowBell.Hint: Toggles the notification bell next to the player list. The center stays reachable via the scene controls.

CampaignId.Name: Atlas campaign ID
CampaignId.Hint: Set automatically once a GM signs in through the login flow below. You can also paste it manually.

Settings.LegacyTokenMigrated: An old Atlas integration token was found and removed for security reasons. Please revoke it in Atlas and sign in again using the login flow below.

ConnectionTest.MissingBaseUrl: Enter an Atlas base URL first.
ConnectionTest.NotFound: Got a 404. Check that /api/v1 is forwarded to the Atlas backend by your reverse proxy.
ConnectionTest.UnexpectedResponse: Atlas responded, but not with the expected health status.
ConnectionTest.Timeout: The request timed out after 5 seconds. Check the URL and that the server is reachable.
ConnectionTest.NetworkOrCors: Could not reach Atlas. This is usually either a wrong URL, or a CORS error — add this Foundry server's URL to ALLOWED_ORIGINS in the Atlas backend. ({detail})
ConnectionTest.UnexpectedError: The connection test failed unexpectedly. See the browser console for details.

Search.Title: Atlas Search
Search.MinLength: Type at least 2 characters to search.
Search.NoResults: Nothing found — you may not have access to matching documents.

ApiError.Auth: You need to sign in to Atlas again.
ApiError.Forbidden: You don't have permission for this in Atlas.
ApiError.NotFound: This content no longer exists or isn't shared with you.
ApiError.Server: Atlas reported an internal error. Please try again later.
ApiError.Network: Could not reach Atlas. Check your connection and the base URL in the settings.
ApiError.Unknown: Something went wrong talking to Atlas.

Auth.LogoutOfflineHint: Could not reach Atlas to revoke the link on the server. You've been signed out here — revoke the token in Atlas' settings too if you want to fully disable it.
Auth.LegacyTokenDiscarded: Atlas sign-ins are now kept per Foundry user. Please connect to Atlas once more.

Status.Revoked: Link expired or revoked — sign in again.
Status.WorldMismatch: This link belongs to a different Foundry world — sign in again.
Status.CampaignMismatch: This sign-in belongs to a different campaign than this world — connect again.

Login.Title: Connect to Atlas
Login.PopupBlocked: Your browser blocked the new tab — use "Open Atlas again" below to confirm the connection.
Login.StartFailed: Could not start the Atlas login. Check the base URL in the settings and try again.
Login.PollFailed: Something went wrong while waiting for confirmation. Please try again.
Login.Denied: The login was declined in Atlas.
Login.Expired: The code expired before it was confirmed. Try connecting again.
Login.CampaignMismatch: You confirmed a different campaign than the one already linked to this world. The token was discarded and revoked — ask your GM if this world should be relinked.
Login.ExchangeFailed: The login was confirmed, but Atlas rejected the resulting token. Please try again.
Login.PlayerWaitingForGm: Your GM needs to link this world to an Atlas campaign first (sign in as GM) before players can connect.
Login.TabOpened: Atlas has opened in a new tab. Confirm the connection there — this window closes by itself.

Links.PrivacyHint: The link's name and label are visible to every player who can see this Foundry object — the content itself stays protected.
Links.CheckFailed: Visibility check failed — is Atlas reachable?
Links.NoneVisible: No links you have access to.
Links.NoTargets: No target available — select a scene, a token, or open a sheet.

Notifications.Title: Atlas Notifications
Notifications.MarkAllReadManyHint: Marking {count} notifications read one by one — this may take a moment.
Notifications.SuggestOpenToast: The GM wants to show you "{name}".
